description: AI Adoption. Executive view of agent adoption, token consumption, tool usage and users. KPI cards compare the last 24 hours with the previous 24 hours. Applications, agents and models are discovered from standard GenAI telemetry. Users, conversations and skills come from traces in the selected range.

panels.title: Agents
panels.description: Distinct agents reporting agent telemetry. Last 24 hours vs previous 24 hours.

targets.expr: count(count by (gen_ai_agent_name)(increase(gen_ai_invoke_agent_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_agent_name!=""}[24h])))

panels.title: Users
panels.description: Distinct users on workflow traces in the selected range (max 1000 traces). Trace-only dimension.

panels.title: Models
panels.description: Distinct models with inference calls. Last 24 hours vs previous 24 hours.

targets.expr: count(count by (gen_ai_request_model)(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_request_model!=""}[24h])))

panels.title: Applications
panels.description: Distinct applications emitting workflow telemetry. Last 24 hours vs previous 24 hours.

targets.expr: count(count by (service_name)(increase(gen_ai_invoke_workflow_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application"}[24h])))

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Workflow runs. Last 24 hours vs previous 24 hours.

targets.expr: sum(increase(gen_ai_invoke_workflow_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application"}[24h]))

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Input plus output tokens. Last 24 hours vs previous 24 hours.

targets.expr: sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model"}[24h])) + sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_output_tokens_total{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model"}[24h]))

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Input plus output tokens. Last 24 hours vs previous 24 hours.

targets.expr: sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model"}[24h])) + sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_output_tokens_total{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model"}[24h]))

panels.title: Avg latency
panels.description: Mean inference duration. Last 24 hours vs previous 24 hours.

targets.expr: sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_duration_seconds_sum{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model"}[24h])) / clamp_min(sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model"}[24h])), 1) and (sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model"}[24h])) > 0)

panels.title: Avg TTFT

targets.expr: sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_time_to_first_chunk_seconds_sum{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model"}[24h])) / clamp_min(sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_time_to_first_chunk_seconds_count{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model"}[24h])), 1) and (sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_time_to_first_chunk_seconds_count{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model"}[24h])) > 0)

panels.title: Cache hit rate

targets.expr: 100 * sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_cache_read_input_tokens_total{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model"}[24h])) / clamp_min(sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model"}[24h])), 1) and (sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model"}[24h])) > 0)

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (gen_ai_request_model)(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent"}[$__range])))

sum(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_duration_seconds_count{deployment_environment=~"$environment", service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", error_type!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Avg TPOT
